title: Elimination of a unit incidence coefficient
statement: For any commutative ring A, natural number n and g:Fin n -> A, the quotient of A[x_0,...,x_n] by x_0+sum_i g_i x_(i+1) is isomorphic as an A-algebra to A[x_1,...,x_n]. There is such an isomorphism that sends the class of every polynomial p to its substitution at x_0=-sum_i g_i x_i and x_(i+1)=x_i. This includes n=0 and the zero ring. Polynomial rings and quotients use [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring].

proof.text: Use MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv to separate the first variable, and compute that the principal equation maps to X-C(-sum_i g_i x_i). Ideal.quotientEquivAlg transports the quotient. Polynomial.quotientSpanXSubCAlgEquiv evaluates the remaining univariate polynomial at the negative sum. Compare the resulting map with aeval on the variables using MvPolynomial.algHom_ext.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_bertiniIncidenceElimination
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → A) :
    ∃ e :
      (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) A ⧸ Ideal.span
        {(X 0 + ∑ i : Fin n, C (g i) * X i.succ :
          MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) A)}) ≃ₐ[A] MvPolynomial (Fin n) A,
      ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) A,
        e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) =
          aeval (Fin.cases (-∑ i : Fin n, C (g i) * X i) X) p
